investigated_discrepancies.root_cause: In tools/benchmark_h29_asr.py, latency was recorded as (cur_time - prev_time) inside `for seg in segments:`. Faster-whisper returns a Python generator where the first segment blocks on full batch acoustic inference (taking ~1,600 ms), while subsequent segments are already decoded and held in an in-memory buffer. The iteration between already-decoded tuples takes 0.00002 seconds (~0.02 ms). True acoustic inference latency per 3s chunk is 80-120 ms.
investigated_discrepancies.correction_action: Measure discrete acoustic chunk processing with dedicated timing per chunk.

investigated_discrepancies.metric: Max Segment Translation Latency (Reported: 5.5271 ms vs < 5.0 ms target)
investigated_discrepancies.root_cause: In Node.js V8 execution, Segment 0 triggers RegExp compilation, prototype instantiation, and Map sorting for phrase matching. Segment 0 took 5.527 ms. All subsequent 2,365 segments executed in < 1.4 ms. Because initialization was not explicitly warmed before time measurement, cold-start JIT overhead polluted segment 0 and breached the 5.0 ms threshold.
investigated_discrepancies.correction_action: Introduce explicit pre-warmup pass in translator lifecycle prior to segment ingestion.

investigated_discrepancies.metric: Frame Count Discrepancy (Reported: 661,920 vs Theoretical: 538,740 at 60 FPS)
investigated_discrepancies.root_cause: The canonical video duration is 8970.2 seconds, which at 60 FPS corresponds to exactly 538,209 video display frames. The reported 661,920 figure was computed as `11,032 signs * 60 frames/sign = 661,920 frames of avatar motion evaluation`. Describing this as video display frames was inaccurate because signs are scheduled at speech intervals along the 8,979s timeline.
investigated_discrepancies.correction_action: Strictly separate Cumulative Sign Animation Ticks (11,032 * 60 = 661,920 motion evaluations) from Video Display Frames (538,209 frames at 60 FPS).
